`final class TweenEquations`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.animation.tween` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TweenEquations.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/animation/tween/TweenEquations.java)

Every easing curve of JOID as a constant, and the lookup of a curve by its name.

## Description

`IN` curves start slowly, `OUT` curves end slowly, `IN_OUT` curves do both.
The catalog shows every curve.

- [Animation](/use/learn/style-and-motion/animation/)

<a id="TweenEquations-method-of"></a>

### of

`TweenEquation of(String name)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

`BackTweenEquation BACK_OUT` 

Goes past the end a little before it settles.

<a id="TweenEquations-constant-BACK_IN_OUT"></a>

`BounceTweenEquation BOUNCE_IN`
